covenant.title: BlessCupid User Covenant
covenant.intro: BlessCupid is a place for Christians — Catholic, Protestant, Pentecostal, Orthodox, mainline — to meet someone with marriage in mind, or to find Christian friends and community. Our v1 dating surface matches men with women only. If that isn't what you're looking for, we're not the right product for you on the dating side. The friendship and community sides are open to everyone over 18 who wants to meet other Christians without a romantic frame.
covenant.body:
1. I'm here with intent. I'm open to marriage, or I'm here for Christian friendship, or I'm here for community. Not for hookups.

2. I'll be myself. My name, my photos, and my faith are real. I won't pretend to be in a tradition I'm not in to date someone.

3. I'll treat the people I meet here as image-bearers of God. No sexual messages or photos before marriage. No demeaning anyone's body, mind, family, or background.

4. I won't use faith as pressure. I won't say "God told me you're my spouse" to push someone. I won't ask for money, meetings, or private photos with a spiritual reason attached.

5. I'll disagree gently across traditions. Catholic and Protestant, charismatic and Reformed — same household, different rooms. I can hold my own conviction without calling another tradition fake.

6. I'll welcome the people I'd want to be welcomed back. Divorced, single parents, widowed, recently converted, doubting, hurt by a church before — they belong here.

7. I'll take correction without shame, and offer it the same way. If I cross a line, I'll listen. If I report someone, I'll expect us to be treated like people, not cases.
covenant.acknowledgment: I've read this and I agree. I understand BlessCupid is for Christian users 18 and up, that the v1 dating surface is man–woman only, and that I'll be held to these seven points the same way I hope to hold others.
covenant.declineNote: That's okay. We'd rather you walk away today than feel pressured into a community you don't want. You can come back anytime.
covenant.sameSexNote: We saw you, and we're not condemning you. BlessCupid v1 is a man–woman dating product. That's our scope. We don't offer same-sex matching here, and we'd rather be upfront with you than waste your time. The friendship and community surfaces are open to you if you want to use them; the dating side is not the right fit.

requirements.title: Add a clear face photo
requirements.body: We require a clear photo of your face so others can connect with the real you. Please avoid body-only photos.

rejection.no_face_detected: We couldn't find a face in this photo. Please try one where your face is clearly visible — that's how others get to know you.
rejection.face_too_small: Your face is a little small in this one. Could you try a closer shot? A clear face helps real conversation.
rejection.multiple_faces: We saw more than one face. For your primary photo, please upload one of just you. (Group photos are great for a secondary slot.)
rejection.low_confidence: We couldn't get a clear read on this photo — maybe the lighting or angle. Please try another.
rejection.unsafe: This photo doesn't fit our Holy Code of Conduct. BlessCupid is a clothes-on, face-forward space. Please choose a different photo.

rejection.block: Your bio didn't fit our Holy Code of Conduct, so we couldn't publish it as written. A reminder: this space is marriage-minded, faith-rooted, and clothes-on in tone. Please rewrite and try again.
rejection.review: Thank you. Your bio is being read by our team — we'll let you know within a day. While you wait, you can still browse and pray for whoever crosses your screen.

message.block: That message didn't fit our Holy Code of Conduct, so we held it back. BlessCupid is for marriage-minded conversation — let's keep talking, just not like that.
message.blockToast: We held that one back — it crossed our Holy Code of Conduct. Try again, friend.
message.blockSexual: We're a marriage-minded space, so we kept that message off the thread. When in doubt, ask: would I say this in front of a pastor?

softWarning.offPlatform: Heads up — moving fast off-platform is the most common way things go wrong on faith-based dating. Take your time. If they're the one, they'll wait for the right pace.
softWarning.offPlatformEscalated: A note from our team: this thread has been flagged for fast off-platform pressure. We're not stopping the conversation, but we're watching it. Please slow down.
softWarning.photoRequest: Heads up — photo requests early in a thread are a common pattern that leads to harm. You don't owe anyone a photo to prove yourself. Take your time.
